en: Black‑and‑white view of a European urban square or park framed by ornate late‑19th / early‑20th‑century apartment buildings. At the center, behind a line of young conifer trees, stands a large statue of a man in a long coat pointing or gesturing with one arm outstretched. Ground in the foreground is a sandy or worn lawn area bordered by a low fence. Shopfronts at street level include signage for a hotel and a cafe‑salon.
